queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) AS t, COUNT(*) AS n FROM counts
)
SELECT c.observstation,
       c.cnt AS telescope_count,
       CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / total.t AS share,
       CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / total.t - 1.0 / total.n AS share_minus_avg
FROM counts c, total
WHERE CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / total.t > 1.0 / total.n
ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS cnt
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
tot AS (
  SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS total_t,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observatories) AS n_obs
)
SELECT c.observstation,
       c.cnt AS telescope_count,
       CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / tot.total_t AS share,
       CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / tot.total_t - 1.0 / tot.n_obs AS share_minus_avg
FROM counts c, tot
WHERE CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / tot.total_t > 1.0 / tot.n_obs
ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT observstation, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.observstation, s.cnt AS telescope_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg
FROM shares s, avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC, s.observstation ASC
LIMIT 10;
